name: Klaus Seishirou
source:
Likes: Cars and bikes
Dislikes: Alcohol, getting old, tobacco, women

The head butler of the Sanzenin household. He has a low alcohol tolerance, doesn't do well with tobacco or women, and likes cars and bikes. He challenges Hayate often where the losing condition would be Hayate getting fired.

[From [url=http://hayatenogotoku.wikia.com/wiki/Seishirou_Klaus]Hayate no Gotoku Wiki[/url]]
